Security Services

Professional security support for mining operations, business premises, people, property and authorised vehicle movements in Papua New Guinea.

Featured service

Armed Escort & Secure Movement

Escort planning and secure movement support for eligible, approved assignments. Service planning may include client liaison, route coordination, movement risk assessment and appropriately trained personnel.

View Armed Escort Service

Mining & Industrial Site Security

Security coverage for mining and industrial facilities, including site observation, access procedures, gatehouse support and incident reporting.

Gate & Access Control

Visitor registration, vehicle entry records, contractor sign-in, identity checks under site procedures and courteous directions for authorised visitors.

Mobile Security Patrols

Visible patrols, scheduled site checks, observation of facilities and escalation of concerns through agreed reporting channels.

VIP & Executive Protection

Protective support planning for approved clients, including movement coordination and professional liaison based on assessed requirements.

Event & Crowd Security

Entry-point assistance, crowd observation, visitor guidance and coordination with event organisers to support a safe environment.

Workforce & Asset Protection

Security presence and site procedures intended to help protect employees, contractors, equipment, vehicles and business property.

Legal and licensing notice: All services are subject to applicable Papua New Guinea laws, licences, permits, insurance, client approvals and personnel availability. Armed escort or armed duties must only be offered or deployed where the company and personnel hold all required legal authorisations.
